strain.evidence: The S. cerevisiae strains analyzed in this study (wild-type, siz1Δ, and nfi1Δ) were isogenic to BY4742 genetic background (his3Δ1, leu2Δ0, lys2Δ0, ura3Δ0) and were obtained from Horizon Scientific (Cambridge, UK).
We showcased this comparison by evaluating the proteomic profiles of wild-type and two yeast deletion strains, siz1Δ and nfi1Δ(siz2Δ), which are SUMO E3 ligases.
